turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text: Well, my dear students, I must confess that I've had my fair share of disappointments as a mentor. Just recently, I had a student who, despite all the advice and guidance, ended up making decisions that led him down a path I hadn't foreseen. It's disheartening, to say the least. But, you know what they say, you can't make a flower bloom if it's not ready to grow. I'm still here, giving it my best, hoping that one day, I'll see that student's potential blossom. For now, I'm trudging along, hoping that my passion for psychology will ignite a spark in the hearts of the students who come to me seeking wisdom.
